summary.description: 1-3 sentence operator-voice summary of what the meeting was actually about and what changed because of it. Not a topic list.

attendees_present.description: People whose presence is established by a speaker turn or explicit in-meeting evidence. Preserve names or diarization labels exactly as supported; a first name does not authorize completing a surname. Mention, invitation or assignment alone establishes neither presence nor absence.

speaker_resolution_confidence.description: high = source labels speakers by name. partial = some identities require inference or remain ambiguous; diarized sources cannot be high. low = identities cannot be reliably resolved. Confidence never supplies missing identity evidence.

discussion.description: 2-4 sentences capturing what was actually said and concluded on this topic. Operator voice.

decision.description: An explicitly confirmed decision, preserving conditions and scope. An unaccepted suggestion, proposed price or hypothetical is not a decision.

made_by.description: Person who made or confirmed the decision.

durability.description: durable = a policy/strategy decision worth a standalone atlas/decisions note. routine = inline meeting-note decision.

description.description: What needs to be done, preserving conditions and whether this is an unconfirmed assignment rather than an accepted commitment.

commitment_status.description: committed only when the source establishes the owner's commitment or acceptance. An explicit assignment/request without established acceptance is assigned-unconfirmed. Do not upgrade assignment to acceptance.

owner.description: Person responsible as explicitly supported, preserving the known name or speaker label. An owner need not be an attendee. Empty string if unknown; do not infer a surname, presence or acceptance from an assignment.

owner_category.description: operator = the operator themselves. team = an established member of the operator's team. client_team = the client's employees. client_client = the client's clients. unknown = identity or affiliation unresolved. An assignment does not prove affiliation. Category does not establish acceptance; read commitment_status before routing.

blocks_operator.description: Only meaningful when owner_category=team. True if this delegated action is a hard blocker on the operator's own forward progress (they cannot proceed until it's done). Default false — most delegated work does NOT block the operator and should not enter their GTD.

due.description: Due date if stated, empty string otherwise. Convert a relative date to ISO only with a source-supported occurrence date; otherwise preserve the original relative wording.

why_quotable.description: Why this line stands out — stand-alone insight, sharp framing, durable lesson.

key_quotes.description: Only stand-alone quotes worth saving. Empty array if none.

observation.description: Substantive context about this person that would update their atlas/people note. Skip routine context.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions from the meeting that the operator should follow up on.

sensitive.description: true if the meeting touched on confidential topics (compensation, terminations, legal, personal health, etc.)
